title: Forest Glen
address:
2001 South Street

description:
Forest Glen is a $28 million affordable housing community for low-income seniors 62 and older in Titusville, spread across more than 11 acres. Its 80 apartments — 72 one-bedroom and 8 two-bedroom units — range from 680 to 947 square feet.

Residents share a multipurpose clubhouse, a fitness center, a swimming pool, a bocce ball court, BBQ grill stations, and a dog park, along with weekly wellness check-ins, social events, and a financial management program.
